messages:
emily: Getting a 403 when switching projects in the console after running an API call as a service account. Repro steps: 1) use SA key to call /v1/models, 2) go to console -> switch org/project -> 403. Screenshot sent. Anyone seen this? @jordan

jordan: Can you paste the exact error payload and which service account you used? Also which org you were trying to switch to?

emily: Error payload: `{"error":"403","message":"You do not have permission to access project 9876"}`. SA email: infra-bot@acme.prod. Trying to switch from Org A -> Org B.

sam: Suspect a cross-account SA binding issue. We had a bug where SA sessions could get bound to the org of the most recent API call. Quick check: can you try an incognito window or clear cookies and retry? :thinking_face:

emily: Incognito = same result. I reproduced on my laptop and on my phone. Odd behaviour: if I revoke the SA key and create a new key it works briefly (~10s) then goes back to 403 once CI runs.

rina: Do you have the audit/session logs handy? Jordan — can you pull the auth logs for infra-bot@acme.prod around the timestamps?

deploy-bot: New deployment to auth-service at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z - version v2.4.1

cleo: Heads up — we shipped a TTL caching change for service-account -> org mapping in v2.4.1. If CI calls the API with that SA and includes X-Org-ID the mapping can stick longer than intended. Can you paste the exact curl you ran (headers)?

emily: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SA_KEY>' -H 'X-Org-ID: 555' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
Response: 200 OK. Immediately after that, trying to switch to Org 555 in the console returns 403.

jordan: Filing as INC-9872 and looping in cleo + sam. Temporary workaround (internal): POST /internal/auth/resync?sa=infra-bot@acme.prod — this clears the binding for that SA. Rina, can you run the resync for emily?

rina: Ran resync at 3923456800 and cleared bindings for infra-bot@acme.prod. emily, can you retry the console switch now?

emily: Retried now — switching works again. Thanks! :tada:

cleo: Root cause: org-binding cache TTL was accidentally set to 24h for SA keys instead of ephemeral. That made SA sessions sticky when used across orgs. We'll push a fix to auth-service and backfill resyncs for affected SAs. Patch scheduled for tomorrow's deploy window.

jordan: I'll document the support playbook in the ticket: (1) run internal resync, (2) revoke + replace SA key if immediate, (3) advise customers to avoid cross-org calls with the same SA until patch. Also notify any customers who reported similar.

emily: One more note — this happened because the same service account email was provisioned in two orgs via federation. Might be useful to warn customers about SA email collisions.

cleo: Agreed. We'll include a bullet about unique SA identities and add a diagnostics check to detect cross-org SA collisions. Leaving INC-9872 open until post-deploy verification.
